mentions.name: 52-Part Retention Lecture Series
mentions.description: A 52-part lecture series on user retention. Each week covers one aspect of retention through research and teaching, applied to two real-world products built by the author; five lectures have been published so far.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on a 52-part series about retention.

Each week I research one part of retention, teach it, and apply it to two real-world products I built.

I’ve published five lectures so far, and think the series should be useful to anyone here building a product
